title: Masala Chai Blend, 100g
tagline: Loose-leaf Assam black tea with cardamom, ginger and cinnamon.
description: Strong Assam leaves blended with whole green cardamom, dried ginger, cinnamon bark and a few cloves. Simmer a spoonful with milk and sugar for proper chai, or brew it like regular tea. The tin holds about 40 cups and keeps the spices fresh.

title: Strawberry Preserve, 220g
tagline: Small-batch jam with big fruit pieces and less sugar.
description: Cooked in small pans with whole strawberries, a squeeze of lemon and less sugar than shop jam, so it tastes of fruit first. Lovely on toast, in yogurt or swirled into a cake. Keep it in the fridge once opened and use within four weeks.

title: Wool Lounge Socks (2 Pairs)
tagline: Thick, soft wool socks in slate blue and oat.
description: Two pairs of chunky socks knitted from a warm wool blend, with a ribbed cuff that stays up without pinching. Made for cold floors, reading in bed and long weekends. One size fits most adult feet; wash cool and dry flat.

title: Sage Knit Scarf
tagline: A long, soft scarf with a fringe at each end.
description: Knitted in a muted sage green from a soft acrylic-and-wool blend that doesn't itch. It's long enough to loop twice and finished with a short fringe. Warm without being bulky, and easy to wear with almost anything.

title: Leather Card Holder
tagline: Slim vegetable-tanned leather with hand stitching.
description: Cut from a single piece of vegetable-tanned leather and stitched by hand with waxed thread. It holds four to six cards plus a folded note, and slips into a front pocket. The leather darkens and softens beautifully with use.

title: Brass Key Ring
tagline: A solid brass loop and key that only gets better with age.
description: A chunky solid-brass ring with a little brass key charm. It's heavy enough to find in a bag and develops a warm patina over time. Polish it with a soft cloth if you like it shiny. Fits four to six keys.

title: Blue Glaze Noodle Bowl
tagline: A deep stoneware bowl for ramen, soups and big salads.
description: Wheel-thrown stoneware in a deep ocean-blue glaze with a cream rim. It holds about 900 ml, enough for a full bowl of noodles with toppings. Comes with a pair of bamboo chopsticks. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

title: Ceramic Soap Dish
tagline: Ridged sage dish that keeps your soap bar dry.
description: A small stoneware dish in a soft sage glaze with raised ridges, so water drains away and your soap lasts longer. It also works as a ring dish or catch-all by the sink. About 5 inches across.

title: Clay Incense Holder + 20 Sticks
tagline: A hand-shaped clay dish with sandalwood incense.
description: A little boat-shaped holder pressed from terracotta clay, with a hole that fits standard sticks and catches the ash. It comes with 20 sandalwood sticks that burn for about 40 minutes each. A calm, warm scent that isn't overpowering.

title: Mini Glass Terrarium Kit
tagline: Everything to build a tiny garden in a jar.
description: A small glass globe with a wooden lid, plus pebbles, activated charcoal, potting mix, moss and a step-by-step card. Add a small cutting or succulent and it more or less looks after itself. It takes about 15 minutes to build. Plant not included.

title: A5 Sketchbook, 120 Pages
tagline: Thick cream paper that takes pencil, ink and light watercolour.
description: Section-sewn so it lies flat, with 120 pages of 150gsm cream paper and a sturdy charcoal cover. Pencil, fine-liner and light washes all behave nicely. An elastic band keeps it closed in your bag. A pencil isn't included.

title: Beginner Embroidery Kit
tagline: A wooden hoop, threads and a simple floral pattern to stitch.
description: Includes a 6-inch wooden hoop, pre-printed cotton fabric, six colours of embroidery floss, two needles and an illustrated guide to four basic stitches. A relaxing evening project that turns into something you can hang on the wall.

title: Beeswax Food Wraps (Set of 3)
tagline: Reusable wraps that replace cling film.
description: Cotton squares coated in beeswax, tree resin and jojoba oil, in small, medium and large. Warm them with your hands to mould them over bowls, cheese or half a lemon. Rinse in cool soapy water and they last about a year.

title: Wooden Wide-Tooth Comb
tagline: Smooth hand-sanded sandalwood, gentle on curls.
description: Cut from sandalwood and sanded smooth by hand, with wide teeth that glide through thick or curly hair without snagging. It doesn't build up static like plastic and has a faint natural scent. About 7 inches long.

title: Linen Napkins (Set of 4)
tagline: Stonewashed linen with a terracotta stripe.
description: Four generous napkins cut from stonewashed linen in natural oat, each with a thin terracotta stripe near the hem. They get softer with every wash and look relaxed even when crumpled. Finished with mitred corners.

title: Wooden Phone Stand
tagline: A solid oak stand for video calls and recipes.
description: Two pieces of oiled oak that slot together, holding a phone or small tablet at a comfortable angle, in portrait or landscape. A gap at the bottom lets the charging cable through. It packs flat for travel.

title: Lavender Sachets (Set of 3)
tagline: Cotton pouches filled with dried French lavender.
description: Three drawstring cotton pouches filled with dried lavender buds. Tuck them in drawers, wardrobes or under a pillow to keep things smelling fresh. Give them a gentle squeeze every few weeks to wake up the scent.

title: Origami Paper Kit
tagline: 200 sheets in 20 colours, plus a folding guide.
description: 200 squares of crisp origami paper in 20 colours, with a fold-out guide to 12 classic models: crane, fox, boat, frog and more. Great for a rainy afternoon, a classroom or anyone who likes busy hands. Suitable from about age 7.

title: Sage Speckle Mug
tagline: Wheel-thrown, 12 oz, with a thumb-friendly handle.
description: Thrown on the wheel in small batches and dipped in a soft sage glaze that breaks into little cream speckles. Holds about 12 oz of coffee or tea. The handle fits three fingers comfortably. Dishwasher safe, though hand washing keeps the glaze glossy longer. No two are exactly alike.

title: Beeswax Taper Candles (Pair)
tagline: Pure beeswax, hand-dipped, about 4 hours each.
description: Two honey-coloured tapers dipped by hand from local beeswax. They burn clean and slow with a faint sweet smell, and they don't drip much if you keep them away from drafts. Each is about 10 inches tall and fits a standard candlestick holder.

title: Striped Linen Tea Towel
tagline: Washed linen that gets softer every time.
description: Cut and hemmed from stonewashed linen with a classic blue stripe at each end. It dries glasses without leaving lint and looks nice hanging on the oven door. A cotton loop in one corner lets you hang it on a hook. About 20 × 28 inches.

title: Kraft Pocket Notebooks (Set of 3)
tagline: Dot grid, 48 pages each, fits a back pocket.
description: Three little notebooks with kraft card covers and stitched spines. Inside is 48 pages of dot-grid paper that handles fountain pens without much bleed. A label on the front gives you somewhere to write what each one is for: lists, sketches, phone numbers. 3.5 × 5.5 inches.

title: Brass Leaf Bookmark
tagline: A solid brass leaf that slips over the page.
description: Cut from a sheet of solid brass and hand-polished. The leaf hooks over the top of the page so it never falls out. Over time it darkens to a warm antique colour; a quick rub with a cloth brings back the shine. Comes in a small paper sleeve, ready to give.

title: “Stay Kool” Enamel Pin
tagline: Hard enamel, gold-tone edges, rubber clutch.
description: Our cheerful little mascot as a 1.25-inch hard enamel pin. Smooth to the touch, with gold-tone edges and a rubber clutch on the back so it stays put on a jacket, bag strap or lanyard. Backed on a small illustrated card.

title: Mustard Hand-Knit Beanie
tagline: Chunky merino blend with a big pom-pom.
description: Knit by hand from a soft merino-and-alpaca blend in a warm mustard yellow. The ribbed brim folds up and the oatmeal pom-pom is firmly attached. One size fits most adults. Warm but not itchy. Hand wash cold and dry flat.

title: Little Terracotta Pot & Saucer
tagline: 4-inch pot with a matching saucer and drainage hole.
description: Classic unglazed terracotta that breathes, so roots don't sit in water. The 4-inch pot comes with its own saucer and a drainage hole in the bottom. It suits herbs, succulents or a small cutting on the windowsill. The plant isn't included, sorry!

title: Olive Wood Cooking Spoon
tagline: Carved from a single piece of olive wood.
description: Each spoon is carved from one piece of olive wood, so the grain is different on every one. Long enough for deep pots and gentle on non-stick pans. Oil it with any food-safe oil now and then and it will last for years. About 12 inches long.

title: Watercolour Postcard Set (6)
tagline: Six painted landscapes, blank on the back.
description: Six postcards printed from small watercolour paintings: hills, a lake, a field of wildflowers and a few other quiet places. They're printed on thick, slightly textured card, with plain backs for writing on. Nice to send, or to frame as a little set.

title: Sunny Canvas Tote
tagline: Heavy cotton canvas with a screen-printed sun.
description: A sturdy tote made from 12 oz cotton canvas with long handles that sit comfortably on your shoulder. The sun on the front is screen-printed by hand, so the ink is a little uneven in places. It's big enough for groceries, a laptop or a beach towel.

title: Woven Jute Coasters (Set of 4)
tagline: Hand-woven jute, about 4 inches across.
description: Four round coasters coiled and stitched by hand from natural jute. They protect tables from warm mugs and cold glasses and add a bit of texture to a coffee table. Shake them out or give them a quick vacuum to clean.

title: Wildflower Honey, 250g
tagline: Raw, unfiltered honey from a small local apiary.
description: Raw honey from bees that forage on clover, blackberry and whatever's flowering that season, so each batch tastes slightly different. It's unheated and unfiltered and will crystallise naturally over time; stand the jar in warm water to loosen it. 250g glass jar.

title: House Roast Coffee Beans, 250g
tagline: Medium roast with chocolate and toasted-nut notes.
description: Our everyday coffee: a medium roast of Brazilian and Colombian beans that tastes of cocoa, toasted hazelnut and a little brown sugar. It works well in a French press, pour-over or espresso machine. Whole beans, roasted in small batches and bagged within a week.

title: Indigo Cotton Bandana
tagline: Soft cotton, block-print pattern, 22 inches square.
description: Lightweight cotton dyed deep indigo, with a simple block-printed pattern in cream. Wear it around your neck or as a headband, tie it to a bag, or use it to wrap a small gift. The colour softens a little with each wash.

title: Wooden Yo-Yo
tagline: Turned beechwood, painted by hand in three colours.
description: A classic wooden yo-yo turned from beech and painted in red, yellow and green rings. It's well balanced, so it sleeps nicely once you get the hang of it. Comes with a spare cotton string. A good stocking-filler for kids, or for grown-ups at their desk.

title: Small Macramé Wall Hanging
tagline: Cotton cord knotted onto a wooden dowel.
description: Knotted by hand from soft natural cotton cord and hung on a smooth wooden dowel. It's about 12 inches wide and 18 inches long including the fringe, which is just right above a bed, desk or plant shelf. It arrives with a hanging string attached.

title: Oat & Honey Soap Bar
tagline: Cold-process soap with colloidal oats, 110g.
description: A gentle cold-process bar made with olive and coconut oils, colloidal oats and a spoonful of our wildflower honey. It lathers well, smells faintly of warm oats and is kind to dry skin. Let it dry between uses and it will last for weeks.
